board.name: Colorado Medical Board (Division of Professions and Occupations, DORA)

ce.reason: Rule 1.33 is written for physicians, but its attestation clause names "the licensee or applicant"; the exclusion of PAs exists only in a proposed amendment (hearing August 27, 2026) that is not adopted, and C.R.S. 12-240-130.5 was not loaded.

topics.unverifiedItem: Whether the substance use prevention training still applies at renewal (its statute was struck and the rule must be repealed by July 1, 2027)

agreement.text: Every PA has a written collaborative agreement, kept at the primary practice location and given to the board on request. Under 5,000 practice hours, or under 3,000 hours in a new practice area, it takes the form of a supervisory agreement.

unverified: Whether the 30-hour CME rule (3 CCR 713-1 Rule 1.33) applies to PAs: the board's clarifying amendment is proposed, not adopted

board.name: Colorado State Board of Nursing (Division of Professions and Occupations, DORA)

none.reason: No CE for active RN renewal; contact hours are one competency option only for reinstatement.

cycleYears.reason: APR registration renews with the RN license and compact-licensed nurses renew it every two years; the current RN licenses expire 9/30/26.

unverified: How often a single state RN license renews (the board states only the current expiration date)

none.reason: APR registration renews with the RN license, which has no CE for active renewal; no APRN CE hours are set.

cycleYears.reason: APR registration renews with the RN license, every two years.

topics.unverifiedItem: Whether the substance use prevention training still applies at renewal (its statute was struck and the rule must be repealed by July 1, 2027)

condition.question: Do you hold prescriptive authority?
condition.description: Applies to nurse practitioners who prescribe.

unverified: Whether national certification is checked at each APR registration renewal for APRNs without prescriptive authority

condition.question: Do you hold prescriptive authority?
condition.description: Colorado APRNs with prescriptive authority must obtain and maintain national certification.

agreement.text: No practice agreement is required. Provisional prescriptive authority (RXN-P) becomes full after a 750 hour mentorship under a written Mentorship Agreement, completed within three years after provisional authority is granted and kept for three years after completion.
